subject: Operator segregation & rotation audit - encryption evidence delivery
messages:
From: Alice Park <alice.park@evergreen.com>
To: sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Cc: security@evergreen.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Encryption evidence request - operator segregation & rotation

Hi Sean,

We're preparing for a SIG/CAIQ submission and Evergreen's SOC 2 auditor has asked for a focused package around key management controls for tenant BYOK and Redwood-hosted KMS/HSM usage. Specifically they want:

- Operator segregation evidence (who can sign/execute rotations, emergency key unwraps, HSM operator roles)
- Representative rotation logs for the past 90 days showing key rotation events and operator IDs
- A short test plan demonstrating BYOK exportability and wrap/unwrap controls (expected steps & acceptance criteria)
- HSM attestation metadata (firmware attestation time, vendor attestation reference) or how we provisioned the HSM for the tenant

Can you provide a deliverable we can attach to the CAIQ, or point me to a secure folder with the artifacts? We need to submit by 2028-06-10 for the audit intake.

Thanks,
Alice Park
Director, Information Security
Evergreen Financial

(attachment: audit_requirements_evergreen_20280601.pdf)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@evergreen.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, irene_choi@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 02 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption evidence request - operator segregation & rotation

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a concise bundle and include a short narrative for CAIQ reference. Plan:

1) Marissa & Irene will collate operator-role matrix + 90-day rotation log samples.
2) We'll include a BYOK exportability test plan (steps + observed results) and a short note on HSM attestation artifacts.
3) Deliverables will be uploaded to a shared Drive folder and I'll circulate a manifest.

Marissa / Irene — can you take point on artifacts and confirm ETA (EOD Monday 6/5 would be ideal for Evergreen's intake). Ben, please include the HSM attestation reference you have from vendor.

Alice — is there a preferred NDA/secure upload for the NDJSON logs? We can provide a redacted sample in-line and place the full logs in the Drive folder with view-only access.

Sean Gallagher
Head of Customer Security - Redwood Inference
(office) +1 415-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 02 Jun 2028 13:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Encryption evidence request - operator segregation & rotation

Sean / team — attaching the artifacts we discussed. Contents and quick notes: 

Attachments: operator-role-matrix.csv (describes roles: HSM-OPERATOR, KMS-ADMIN, KEY-OWNER; mapping to SSO IDs and break-glass procedures)
kms-rotation-log-sample.ndjson (redacted rotation events, timestamps, operator_id, key_id, rotation_type)
byok-export-test-plan.pdf (test steps + expected outcomes)
evidence_delivery_manifest.txt (short index)

Summary highlights:
- Operator segregation: HSM operator role is restricted to on-call ops; all unwrap/unwrap operations require dual-auth (operator + remote signer) for tenant protected KEKs. The operator-role-matrix lists current authorized operator SSO handles and last access review date (2028-05-21).
- Rotation logs: sample includes three tenant KEK rotations and one emergency key-eviction event; logs include operator_id, ops-ticket id, sequence numbers, and resulting key fingerprint. We redacted IPs and session tokens.
- BYOK exportability: test plan demonstrates wrap-to-customer-key flow: "generate tenant key -> wrap with KEK -> export wrapped artifact -> customer unwrap with local KMS". Acceptance criteria included checksum validation, signature verification, and audit event generation.

Proposed next step: 30-minute call with Alice and Evergreen SecOps to walk the artifacts and answer any auditor questions. Proposed slots: Mon 6/5 09:00-11:00 PT or Mon 6/5 14:00-15:00 PT.

Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference

Marissa — thank you, that looks good as a starting point. Quick clarifications before we schedule:

1) For the HSM attestation metadata — can you include the attestation generation timestamp and the vendor reference ID? Our auditor will want to map firmware versions to the attestation report.
2) For the rotation log samples: can you indicate how the logs are TTL'd/archived and whether we can request a longer historic slice if the auditor asks (we may need 180 days for certain control tests).
3) On BYOK exportability: can your test plan include an explicit failure-mode (e.g., customer unwrap with wrong key -> error code and audit event) so the auditor can see how we detect and log unwrap failures?

If you can update the package with those items and share the Drive link, we'll pick a call slot. Thanks — auditor intake is tight so EOD 6/5 is appreciated.

Regards,
Alice Park
Director, Information Security
Evergreen Financial
